latest.title: DBeaver-Grade Autocomplete & Schema Fallback
latest.summary: Enhanced SQL autocompletion accuracy with exact-match priority ranking, multi-schema dot-trigger resolution, and DBeaver-style SHOW FULL TABLES fallback for restricted database permissions.

highlights.title: Exact-Match Autocomplete Priority
highlights.description: Exact table and column matches now rank highest at the top of suggestions, eliminating keyword collisions on tables named after SQL keywords (e.g., order).

highlights.title: DBeaver-Style Schema Table Fallback
highlights.description: Added SHOW FULL TABLES fallback with backtick-quoted schema identifiers when information_schema access is restricted.

highlights.title: Sub-word Dot Scope Resolution
highlights.description: Fixed dot-trigger parsing so typing partial table names after a schema dot reliably resolves in-scope tables and columns.

history.title: Logo Squircle, Noise Grain Toggle & Dynamic App Identity
